How do I brush pet teeth

Start gradually, allowing your pet to become comfortable with handling around the mouth and pet toothpaste. Use a soft pet toothbrush to gently clean the outer tooth surfaces when your pet tolerates it. Keep sessions calm and reward cooperation. Do not force the mouth open or continue through pain. Ask your vet to demonstrate a suitable technique.

What are signs of dental problems

Possible warning signs include persistent bad breath, red or swollen gums, visible deposits, drooling, difficulty chewing or changes in eating behaviour. These signs have different possible causes and need veterinary assessment. A normal-looking photo does not rule out problems below the gumline.
